## Before you submit

Maintainers do not merge pull requests here. An accepted change is carried into the source repository and credited to its author with a `Co-authored-by` trailer in the commit message. It appears here in the next release of that package. The pull request is then closed with a link to that release.

- [ ] I have named the package.
- [ ] I have explained what changed and why.
- [ ] I have described how I tested the change.
- [ ] I agree that this change may be relicensed under the MIT License.
